title: Speed Up Your Python Program With Concurrency
description: Explore Python concurrency with threading, asyncio, and multiprocessing, and learn which model speeds up your I/O-bound or CPU-bound programs.
summary: Concurrency refers to the ability of a program to manage multiple tasks at once, improving performance and responsiveness. It encompasses different models like threading, asynchronous tasks, and multiprocessing, each offering unique benefits and trade-offs.
takeaways: It encompasses different models like threading, asynchronous tasks, and multiprocessing, each offering unique benefits and trade-offs.
